extends Node
## Third project uses only the Drawing package, not the standalone editor or Atlas.

func _ready() -> void:
	var document: DrawingDocument = DrawingDocument.new("consumer-standalone", 16)
	var group: DrawingResult = document.create_layer(DrawingLayerNode.GROUP, "Nested")
	var layer: DrawingResult = document.create_layer(DrawingLayerNode.RASTER, "Exact", group.value)
	if not group.ok or not layer.ok:
		get_tree().quit(1)
		return
	var x: int = -12345678901234
	var edit: DrawingEditSession = document.begin_edit(String(layer.value), document.revision,
		Transform2D.IDENTITY, x, -17).value
	var rgba: PackedByteArray = PackedByteArray([17, 34, 51, 0])
	if not edit.apply_region(Rect2i(0, 0, 1, 1), rgba).ok or not edit.commit().ok:
		get_tree().quit(1)
		return
	var encoded: DrawingResult = DrawingFileIO.encode(document)
	if not encoded.ok:
		get_tree().quit(1)
		return
	var decoded: DrawingResult = DrawingFileIO.decode(encoded.value)
	if not decoded.ok:
		printerr(decoded.code, ": ", decoded.message)
		get_tree().quit(1)
		return
	var reopened: DrawingDocument = decoded.value as DrawingDocument
	var pixel: DrawingResult = reopened.read_pixel(String(layer.value), x, -17)
	var valid: bool = reopened.id == document.id and reopened.list_children()[0] == group.value and \
		reopened.list_children(String(group.value))[0] == layer.value and pixel.ok and \
		int(pixel.value) == 0x00332211
	if valid:
		print("DRAWING_THIRD_CONSUMER_PASSED")
	get_tree().quit(0 if valid else 1)
